candidate.meaning: The C4 candidate commit on which final/evidence-report.json was generated with an empty `git status --porcelain`. This limitations file, gates.json, credential-scan.json and SHA256SUMS are added by the evidence-backfill commit that follows the candidate.

claimBoundary: Static governance only. Every item below is a metadata check, a document or a test; none is a runtime effect, a product release, a GA claim, a benefit, an adoption or a task-success claim. Passing checks grant nothing; the owners cited in the product-semantics table keep the real authority.

limitations.subject: final/evidence-report.json candidate binding
limitations.statement: The report binds the HEAD it was generated on (the candidate above). Committing it necessarily creates a newer HEAD, so on that HEAD and any later one `node scripts/check-evidence-refs.mjs --verify` returns exit 1 with exactly two diagnostics, candidate-mismatch on candidate.commit and candidate.tree; the eight source digests, the contract version and the normalization policy still match because the backfill commit changes no referenced source. To obtain exit 0, run the checker from a detached worktree at the recorded candidate (CONTRACT-HARDENING.md §7.5). A report that verifies on its own commit cannot exist.

limitations.subject: pnpm run typecheck
limitations.statement: Exit 1 = typecheck:node 0 / typecheck:web 0 / typecheck:test 2. The single error is tests/unit/contract-check.test.ts(171,30) TS7006, introduced by TF-0630 fd2d93a41 (batch A write set) and reproduced by C2, C3 and C4 alike. Zero errors in any batch-C file. This is a pre-existing red, not a pass.

limitations.subject: pnpm harness validate without --since
limitations.statement: Exit 1 because the default diff base origin/main (2b87c1c44) is six unpushed commits behind HEAD and those commits contain decision-round and TF-0632 files outside this spec. `--since HEAD` (the CLOSURE-DECISIONS §4.3 reading for uncommitted work) passes. Environment state; disappears once the chain-closing run pushes.

limitations.subject: pnpm harness validate --spec ontology-lite-existing-contracts-hardening.md --since HEAD
limitations.statement: Exit 1: the umbrella spec's touchedAreas do not list .gitignore, scripts/repository-artifacts.json or docs/dev/architecture-skeleton/CONTRACT-HARDENING.md, which the implementation contract owns. Cross-spec structural result; the implementation contract's validate with --since HEAD passes on the same tree.

limitations.subject: C1 provenance manifest line anchors
limitations.statement: docs/clawx-product-semantics.md grew from 366 to 379 lines (+13 after line 13). The C1 manifest's docBasis lines 299 / 317 / 337 for that document now read 312 / 330 / 350 on the C4 candidate; lines 9 and 13 are unchanged. The manifest is bound to its own candidate b442f5dd5 and was left as written (history is not rewritten).

limitations.subject: report/default-stdout.expected.txt
limitations.statement: Pins 188 referenced paths. Any new path literal in the five evidence files (shared/product-semantics.ts, capability-claims.ts, sensitive-content-boundary.ts, reliability-boundaries.ts, dcs/prod-flags-catalog.ts) or in package.json scripts must update that fixture; this is the explicit cost of the byte-identical default-behaviour contract.

limitations.subject: README.ru-RU.md
limitations.statement: Reviewed with the same no-change conclusion as the three READMEs in the write set (pointer lines 64 / 236 / 246 unchanged), but it is outside the C4 write set of the implementation contract and was not touched.

limitations.subject: scope of the evidence binding
limitations.statement: The report binds only the six PRODUCT_SEMANTIC_RELATIONS and their evidenceRefs. Other registries, the Task Ledger, Workboard, Runtime, Context Family, Memory, Knowledge, approvals and the write journal are referenced, not bound, and keep their own owners.

limitations.subject: same-session quality for routing-memo--quality-gated-by--task-loop
limitations.statement: The static reading proves the owner (resolveRoutingMemoAuthority) requires a server-resolved task_loop_verified_scorecard receipt; it does not prove any live session produced one. A documented same-session claim without such a receipt stays documented-only at runtime.

limitations.subject: credential scan
limitations.statement: Literal credential-token pattern scan over the selected artefacts only (final/ files and the three source files this leaf changed). It is not a comprehensive secret audit and does not scan the referenced source documents.
